task.title: Common Steps
task.shortdesc: Reusable task steps that other topics pull in by conref. This task is a warehouse for shared content and is not published on its own.

step.cmd: Select the region of audio you want to process.

info.p: Click and drag in the waveform to select a region. The selected area appears highlighted in blue. To select the entire track, press Ctrl+A (Windows/Linux) or Cmd+A (macOS).

step.cmd: Save your project by choosing File Save Project Save Project .
